title: Albuquerque Hot Air Balloon Rides - Aerogelic Ballooning
specs: Views of the Sandia Mountain Range, Rio Grande Valley, Cibola National Forest, Manzano Mountains
See the world's longest aerial tramway ascending Sandia Peak
View Old Town Albuquerque with adobe buildings and San Felipe de Neri Church
Fly over Balloon Fiesta Park, site of the Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta
See Kirtland Air Force Base with military aircraft and aviation landmarks
blurb: Since 1976, Aerogelic Ballooning has offered hot air balloon rides in Albuquerque using state-of-the-art equipment and highly trained operators. Flights provide panoramic views of Albuquerque, the Sandia Mountain Range, Rio Grande Valley, and other local landmarks. Guests experience a serene sunrise flight with views of the city's unique charm and natural surroundings.
